Name: Season Planner and Bundle Reminder
Author: jawenmods
Description:
[center]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/devjawen/stardew-season-planner/main/images/1.4.0/Banner.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=6][font=Georgia][b]Season Planner & Bundle Reminder[/b][/font][/size]
[size=3][color=#6b8f61][i]Plan smarter. Deliver faster. Miss nothing.[/i][/color][/size][/center]

[center]
[url=https://smapi.io][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/SMAPI-4.1%2B-2b8a3e?style=flat-square[/img][/url] [url=https://www.stardewvalley.net/][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/Stardew%20Valley-1.6%2B-c0692e?style=flat-square[/img][/url] [img]https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-1.4.0-1f6feb?style=flat-square[/img] [img]https://img.shields.io/badge/Languages-EN%20%7C%20TR%20%7C%20KO-informational?style=flat-square[/img][/center]

[line]

[center][size=4][font=Georgia][b]✦ Why This Mod ✦[/b][/font][/size][/center]

[color=#4a6741]If you keep missing bundle timing windows, this mod gives you a clear daily plan:[/color]

[list]
[*] [b]What[/b] is missing from your bundles
[*] [b]What[/b] is urgent and time-sensitive
[*] [b]Where and when[/b] to get each item
[*] [b]What[/b] to do next — no guesswork
[/list]

Press [b][color=#ffffff][ F5 ][/color][/b] any time to open the panel.

[line]

[center][size=4][font=Georgia][b]✦ Feature Highlights ✦[/b][/font][/size][/center]

[color=#4a6741][b]▸ Bundle Panel[/b][/color] [size=2][color=#888]— F5 to open anywhere[/color][/size]
Open anywhere. Grouped by category, sorted by urgency, with instant real-time search.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/devjawen/stardew-season-planner/main/images/1.4.0/bundlelistpanel.png[/img]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/devjawen/stardew-season-planner/main/images/1.4.0/bundlelistpaneldetails.jpg[/img]

[color=#4a6741][b]▸ Detailed Calendar[/b][/color] [size=2][color=#888]— never miss a deadline[/color][/size]
7-column weekly layout with deadline badges and hover details for every item.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/devjawen/stardew-season-planner/main/images/1.4.0/bundlelistpanelcalendar.png[/img]

[color=#4a6741][b]▸ Planning System[/b][/color] [size=2][color=#888]— mark, track, complete[/color][/size]
Mark items as planned and receive a notification the moment they are completed.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/devjawen/stardew-season-planner/main/images/1.4.0/bundlelistpanelplanned.jpg[/img]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/devjawen/stardew-season-planner/main/images/1.4.0/missingbundlelistplanned.jpg[/img]

[color=#4a6741][b]▸ Museum Tab[/b][/color] [size=2][color=#888]— track every donation[/color][/size]
All donation progress in one dedicated tab. Nothing falls through the cracks.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/devjawen/stardew-season-planner/main/images/1.4.0/bundlelistpanelmuseum.jpg[/img]

[color=#4a6741][b]▸ Smart Tooltips[/b][/color] [size=2][color=#888]— context everywhere[/color][/size]
Inventory, chest, shop, and Community Center ingredient hover tooltips with useful context.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/devjawen/stardew-season-planner/main/images/1.4.0/inventorytooltip.jpg[/img]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/devjawen/stardew-season-planner/main/images/1.4.0/communitycenter.jpg[/img]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/devjawen/stardew-season-planner/main/images/1.4.0/pierreshop1.jpg[/img]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/devjawen/stardew-season-planner/main/images/1.4.0/willys%20shop.jpg[/img]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/devjawen/stardew-season-planner/main/images/1.4.0/sandys%20shop.jpg[/img]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/devjawen/stardew-season-planner/main/images/1.4.0/krabus.jpg[/img]

[color=#4a6741][b]▸ HUD Alerts + Log[/b][/color] [size=2][color=#888]— stay informed daily[/color][/size]
Daily warnings for planting deadlines, rain fish opportunities, and planned item completions. Review your full alert history inside the panel.

[color=#4a6741][b]▸ GMCM Support[/b][/color] [size=2][color=#888]— configure in-game[/color][/size]
All core options configurable in-game via Generic Mod Config Menu.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/devjawen/stardew-season-planner/main/images/1.4.0/genericmodmenusettings.jpg[/img]

[line]

[center][size=4][font=Georgia][b]✦ What's New in 1.4.0 ✦[/b][/font][/size][/center]

[list]
[*] [b]Real-time search bar[/b] — filter bundles and items instantly as you type
[*] [b]Detailed calendar[/b] — weekly view with hover details and deadline badges
[*] [b]Community Center tooltips[/b] — ingredient hints directly on the board
[*] [b]Delivered-state lines[/b] — completed requirements are clearly marked
[*] [b]Notification log tab[/b] — review your full alert history in one place
[*] [b]Better mod fish support[/b] — improved detection for custom fish mods
[*] [b]Korean language support[/b] — full KO translation added (EN · TR · KO)
[*] [b]Bilingual SMAPI logs[/b] — console output in both Turkish and English
[*] [b]Bundle cache reliability fixes[/b] — more stable data across save reloads
[*] [b]Full i18n coverage[/b] — every string now properly localized
[/list]

[line]

[center][size=4][font=Georgia][b]✦ Installation ✦[/b][/font][/size][/center]

[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Stardew Valley [b]1.6+[/b]
[*] [url=https://smapi.io][b]SMAPI 4.1+[/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] [color=#888](optional)[/color]
[/list]

[b]Steps:[/b]
[list=1]
[*] Download the latest file from the Files tab
[*] Extract into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/b]
[*] Launch the game through SMAPI
[/list]

[line]

[center][size=4][font=Georgia][b]✦ Controls ✦[/b][/font][/size][/center]

[list]
[*] [b]F5[/b] — Open or close the panel
[*] [b]ESC / Right-click[/b] — Close panel
[*] [b]Mouse wheel[/b] — Scroll the list
[*] [b]Tab click[/b] — Filter by category
[*] [b]Search box[/b] — Filter by item or bundle name
[*] [b]Plan button[/b] — Mark an item as planned
[*] [b]Drag header[/b] — Move the panel anywhere on screen
[/list]

[line]

[center][size=4][font=Georgia][b]✦ Compatibility ✦[/b][/font][/size][/center]

Supports asset patches through SMAPI content APIs — [i]Data/Bundles, Data/Crops, Data/Shops, Data/Fish, Data/Locations[/i].

[b]Explicitly tested and supported:[/b]
[list]
[*] Content Patcher
[*] Stardew Valley Expanded
[*] Cornucopia — More Crops
[*] Cornucopia — Cooking Recipes
[*] Bonster's Crops
[*] Culinary Delight
[*] Better Things
[*] Json Assets
[*] Dynamic Game Assets
[*] Generic Mod Config Menu
[/list]

[color=#888][i]Most crop / fish / shop / location mods are auto-detected when they patch standard game data assets. Mods with fully custom bundle systems outside vanilla data paths may need future targeted support. If you encounter a conflict, please report it with your SMAPI log and full mod list.[/i][/color]

[line]
